facts.fact: Chathu is sentenced, at Neela's asking, to keep and tend the kennels at the groves for life under Pachan, gagged from dusk to dawn, no writing, no leaving.
facts.why: beat requires Neela to ask the queen to send Chathu to the kennels under Pachan for life

facts.fact: The charter orders the 'Sold to the crown' sums repaid to the named members from the crown's treasury on the first day of the dry season.
facts.why: beat says the sums are owed back to the members; a date is needed to make the clause concrete

facts.fact: The old watch-house has a rusted gate fire-basket; Muthu lends the Company his tent on the shoulder behind it.
facts.why: needed for the burning and the night scene

facts.fact: Devan retains faint sensation in his dead right hand and feels Neela's welts and touch through the wound-share.
facts.why: gives the intimate scene a share-based sensory link without contradicting the nerve injury
